## 🏆 Top Microsoft Power BI & Fabric Analytics Consultants (Canberra & Australia-Wide)

---

### 1. 🥇 AGER BI
**Website:** [agerbi.com.au](https://agerbi.com.au)

AGER BI stands out as one of the most highly credentialled Microsoft analytics consultancies in Australia.

AGER BI provides specialist Power BI consulting services across Australia, and holds certifications including Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate, Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, and Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate.

This makes them particularly well-suited for Canberra's government and public sector clients.

-
Agile Insights is a Microsoft Data & AI consulting partner delivering Power BI, Fabric & Azure solutions, training and managed services across Australia.

They offer comprehensive services for data & AI strategy, platform, integration, analytics and more, as well as tailored Power BI, Dynamics 365, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure AI workshops, plus ongoing managed services to keep systems operational and optimised.

### 3. 🥉 Power BI Consulting Services Australia
**Website:** [powerbi-consulting-services.com.au](https://powerbi-consulting-services.com.au)

This consultancy builds trusted dashboards, financial reporting, semantic models, data automation and Microsoft Fabric-ready reporting solutions, specialising in Power BI, Fabric, data models and executive reporting.
Their Microsoft Fabric Readiness practice covers Lakehouse and Warehouse planning, Dataflow and pipeline patterns, Power BI semantic model strategy, and scalable reporting architecture.

Their approach suits businesses using Excel, Power BI, Microsoft 365, SQL, Fabric, Business Central, MYOB, CRM, ERP, website or operational systems that need better visibility and less manual reporting effort.

### 4. The Virtual Forge

Their Power BI Dashboard Development and Implementation practice covers data warehousing, Power Query/ETL/Data Quality, data modelling, DAX, Paginated Reports, Dataflows, tenant configuration, and row- and object-level security.

### 5. Report Simple
**Website:** [reportsimple.com.au](https://www.reportsimple.com.au/consulting/microsoft-fabric-consulting)

Report Simple specialises in designing and implementing a unified data architecture that connects organisations through OneLake, architecting a single SaaS environment that handles everything from ingestion to insights.

Microsoft Fabric consulting costs typically range from $200 to $250+ per hour for specialist Australian firms, with initial architectural assessments or PoC projects starting between $5,000 and $20,000

— useful as a benchmark when evaluating any of these firms.

---

## 📝 Key Tips for Canberra Clients

- **Government/Public Sector:** Look for firms with **LGCA (Local Government Contracts Australia) Approved Supplier** status or Microsoft Advanced Specialisation — both AGER BI and Agile Insights have relevant credentials.
- **Certifications to look for:** Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Power BI Data Analyst Associate, and Azure Data Engineer Associate are the gold standard.
- **Operational Reporting:** Ensure your chosen consultant has experience with **paginated reports**, DAX, and semantic modelling for operational use cases.
- **Data Warehousing:** Prioritise firms with hands-on experience in **Microsoft Fabric Warehouse, OneLake, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Data Factory**.
